summary: All 11 acceptance criteria pass. Quick Play card is discoverable on HomeScreen between Daily Climb and Challenge cards. Full user flows validated: join -> search (overlay with spinner + cancel) -> match (navigate to /duel/:id) OR timeout (retry + back) OR error (retry + back). Haptics fire at correct points. Accessibility meets requirements (role=dialog, aria-modal, assertive live region, 48px targets). Cleanup properly handles unmount. Recovery from all terminal states works via retry and back buttons. 26 tests cover all state transitions including boundary cases.
goal: Validate 1v1 Quick Play against acceptance criteria

learnings.insight: When useMatchmakingQueue transitions to matched, queueActive (status !== 'idle') is true, so SearchingOverlay briefly renders as an empty dialog div before the navigate effect fires. None of the three inner blocks (searching/timeout/error) match the 'matched' status.
learnings.action: Consider adding status !== 'matched' to the queueActive condition. Not user-visible but eliminates an unnecessary DOM node.

learnings.insight: useMatchmakingQueue has 26 dedicated tests covering all state transitions, error paths, boundary cases (matched without duelId), cleanup behaviors, and haptic assertions. Full suite at 707 tests across 78 files, all passing.
